papers.title: Neural Network identification of Dark Star Candidates. II. Spectroscopy
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, submitted to the Astrophysical Journal
papers.excerpt: Some of the first stars in the Universe might be powered by Dark Matter (DM) annihilations, rather than nuclear fusion.

papers.title: Agentic Systems for Calibrating Cosmological Simulations
papers.comment: Accepted to the 9th annual workshop for Machine Learning & the Physical Sciences (ML4PS). A starter code is available on https://github.com/chaipattira/SimulationCalibrator
papers.excerpt: Calibrating a cosmological simulation is an expensive, high-dimensional parameter optimization task.

papers.title: Machine Learning Sensor Fusion for Water Vapor Radiometry based Tropospheric Delay Calibration
papers.comment: 2 pages, 1 table, Submitted to 2027 National Radio Science Meeting, Boulder, Colorado
papers.excerpt: The next-generation Very Large Array (ngVLA) intends to use 22 GHz water vapor radiometry (WVR) to correct for tropospheric phase fluctuations in its high-frequency bands.
papers.tldr: A machine-learning based retrieval concept and a preliminary architecture, framed as heterogeneous, multi-rate sensor fusion, are proposed to correct for tropospheric phase fluctuations in the next-generation Very Large Array.
